tasks.title: Authelia ↔ Redis health
tasks.desc: Add Redis healthcheck and make Authelia depend on healthy Redis.
tasks.code:
# docker-compose.yml (redis)
healthcheck:
  test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
  interval: 10s
  timeout: 3s
  retries: 5

# docker-compose.yml (authelia)
depends_on:
  redis:
    condition: service_healthy

# verify
docker compose ps
docker inspect $(docker compose ps -q redis) --format '{{json .State.Health}}' | jq

tasks.title: Storage cleanup (docker-data.img)
tasks.desc: Detach any loop devices / handles, then delete image; inspect dmesg for I/O issues.

sudo rm -f /srv/data/docker-data.img
